hooks.name: data-licence-guard
hooks.description: On every agent save under packages/data/**, refuses a dataset without its provenance sheet (packages/data/provenance/<id>.json with recomputed features and sha256) or with a licence outside the permitted set (ODbL-1.0, CC0, public domain, CC BY 4.0 with credit) — data-licences.md, VOY-N-05, spec §6.1. TeleGeography and PeeringDB data must never appear here at all. Same logic as scripts/guards/data-licence.guard.mjs in CI.
